techniques.name: 双层明暗混合头像关注动画
techniques.intent: 照片或视频保留在动态圆形头像内，外侧显示边框和关注图标。

parameters.duration: output seconds, derived from selected resource interval
parameters.blend: darken then lighten, per RGB channel

code_expression.timing: All three layers share start/duration; trim video source rather than extending beyond available frames.
outputs: avatar animation frames and retained sidecar parameters

pitfalls: The actual circle, follow/check animation and bundled sound are resource assets, not generated by a blend name.
A white disc under darken is an identity inside and black outside; the top black ring adds bright details under lighten.
The tutorial suggests multiply as another option; it matches darken only for binary black/white pixels and differs at gray/antialiased edges.
Exact editor blend working space remains unknown; typed compiler uses SDR encoded RGB.
Replacing a source must preserve and revalidate blend state, transforms and duration.
validation: Check avatar visible inside circle, black outside, ring and follow icon retained.
Inspect first/middle/last resource frames and verify all intervals match.
Do not retain resource audio unless actually auditioned under the existing sound policy.

techniques.name: 头像画面覆盖与图层身份
techniques.intent: 避免圆形头像内露出黑边，并确保变换作用于正确素材。

operations: address avatar by stable layer id
calculate cover scale for intended circle bounding box
code_expression.timing: Inspect coverage across the whole animated circle interval, not a single cursor time.

pitfalls: Moving tracks is an old UI selection workaround; code should target layer identity.
One frame fitting does not prove a moving border always covers the source.
validation: Inspect the avatar boundary throughout animation for uncovered bands.
Changing avatar transform does not move the ring or sticker.

techniques.name: 外围装饰与结束提示
techniques.intent: 让装饰围绕头像边界并覆盖完整片尾动画。

operations: adjust transform and inspect animated bounds
code_expression.timing: Leave enough complete ending action and sound tail; do not truncate an animation just because another clip ends.

pitfalls: Exact sticker resources are not included.
No sound audition was performed; ASR saying a resource has sound is not audio approval.
validation: Check border/sticker alignment at first/middle/last and motion extremes.
Confirm text/subject readability and use only reviewed sound.

unknowns: No continuous playback or audio audition.
ASR remains unverified; exact sound and sticker identity/rights unknown.
Exact editor blend processing and envelope are not certified.
